sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 705
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 705
ACT XLVII OF 2021
NATIONAL COLLEGE OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION
AND ECONOMICS, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the National College of Business
Administration and Economics, Lahore Ordinance,
2002
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th December, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(87)/2021/2714, dated 24.12.2021.---The National College of Business Administration and Economics, Lahore
(Amendment) Bill 2021, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on December 21, 2021, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on
December 24, 2021, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the National College of Business Administration and
Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance XX of 2002) in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---This Act
may be cited as the National College of Business Administration and Economics,
Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Whereas

hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of Punjab as follows:
5. Substitution
of section 8 of Ordinance XX of 2002.---In the Ordinance, for section 8, the following shall be substituted:
"8.
Board of Governors.---(1) The Board of the Institute shall consist of the
following:
(i) Chief
Executive of the Company who shall be the Chairman of the Board;
(ii) Directors
of the Company subject to a maximum of four Directors to be nominated by the
Company;
(iii) three
persons of eminence, including at least one woman, in the field of education,
research and industry to be nominated by the Company;
(iv) three
members of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, including at least one woman
member, to be nominated by the Speaker;
(v) Secretary
to the Government, Higher Education Department or his nominee;
(vi) Chairman,
Higher Education Commission, Islamabad or his nominee not below the rank of a
director;
(vii) A
Vice Chancellor of a public sector university in Punjab to be nominated by the
Patron; and
(viii) Rector (Member/Secretary).
(2) The
quorum for a meeting of the Board shall be one half of the total number-of the
members, a fraction being counted as one."
